preferenceMagnitude.rule: Preference magnitude is diagnostic only and cannot increase comparison confidence.

components.pairwiseConditionMatch: Same position, engine context, search condition, score perspective, movetime and depth.
components.scoreDomainComparability: Centipawn claims compare only to centipawn; mixed centipawn/mate domains are not directly comparable.
components.firstMoveTraceability: Each candidate first move is candidate-specific and traceable to source evidence.
components.sequenceStableThroughClaimedHorizon: Every claim actually eligible for output lies within its required stable horizon.
components.provenanceCompleteness: All claims eligible for output retain source evidence IDs and source moves.
